lean.plain: Two clean SELECT calls with shared Bell parity
lean.annotation: The manuscript reuses the Bell parity across two swap blocks because the intervening operation leaves the system untouched. In Lean, `hTurnSupp` excludes both the system wires and the stored parity wire from `P_turn`’s support; under the theorem’s other hypotheses, the paired SELECT circuit with its surrounding operations cleanly realizes the stated composition.

lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.P450GroundEnergy.Solution.BellAsymCore.cleanRealizesSet_bellFiveStepNoNegCoreSliceDyn_asym
lean.plain: Two clean SELECT calls with shared Bell parity
lean.annotation: The swap multiplies the antisymmetric Bell state by $-1$ and fixes the three symmetric Bell states. A CNOT and a Hadamard send the antisymmetric state to $|11\rangle$. Computing the parity of such pairs and applying a controlled $Z$ implements the block of controlled swaps. The Lean statement verifies the clean composition of two SELECT calls with an intervening reflection.

statements.markdown: each block can instead be implemented as a single controlled sign flip
